title: Stocking figures without guessing
target: How to stock the figure line in a TCG Card Shop Simulator shop, given that the figures come as a named set with icons, that several have evolved versions, and that the statues are a larger set with shiny variants.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shelf or a counter with room on it
Enough money to buy more than one kind
A note of which creatures you already carry

steps.do: Buy the figures by creature rather than as one generic line.
steps.because: the figures are shipped with an icon each, a bat, a beetle, a fox, a golem, a piggy, a starfish and a toon among them (Icon_Toy_BatB, Icon_Toy_Beetle, Icon_Toy_FoxB, Icon_Toy_GolemB, Icon_Toy_PiggyB, Icon_Toy_StarfishB, Icon_Toy_ToonZ)

steps.do: Put the evolved versions out beside the basic ones instead of hiding them.
steps.because: several families are named in more than one version, with an evolved form beside them (Icon_Toy_PiggyEvo, Icon_Toy_StarfishEvo, Icon_Toy_BatD, Icon_Toy_GolemD)

steps.do: Let the podium do the work: a figure is meant to stand on one.
steps.because: the podiums are named as objects of their own, with a dark and a dark shiny material (StatuePodium, MAT_StatuePodium_Dark, MAT_StatuePodium_DarkShinny)

steps.do: Fill a corner with the larger statues rather than only small figures.
steps.because: the statue set runs past the dragons, a beetle, a shellfish, a fox, a tree and a wisp among them (Interactable_MonsterStatue_Beetle, Interactable_MonsterStatue_ShellfishD, Interactable_MonsterStatue_FoxD, Interactable_MonsterStatue_TreeD, Interactable_MonsterStatue_Wisp)

steps.do: Keep the shiny versions for the part of the shop you want to stand out.
steps.because: shiny versions of several statues are named beside the ordinary ones (Interactable_MonsterStatue_ShinyGolemA, Interactable_MonsterStatue_ShinyPiggyA)

commonMistakes: Buying one creature in bulk and calling the shelf stocked.
Leaving podiums unbought so the figures sit on bare counter.
Mixing the tiny figures and the large statues on the same shelf.
Treating the shiny versions as a different product instead of the same creature.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
